components.name: RA2AYRMB application code
components.scope: Repository and source archive; its GPL-2.0-or-later option permits the Windows distribution to use GPL-3.0 for this release

components.name: RA2AYRMB Windows combined application distribution
components.scope: Combined application distribution; separately licensed libraries retain their own terms
components.review: The project GPL-2.0-or-later grant permits GPL-3.0, which is the version used by the included XCC data; this package does not claim a later-version option for the combined work.

components.name: XCC MIX name lists
components.scope: Repository, source archive, and Windows package data; not covered by the project-code licenses
components.review: The release checker matches the GPL-3.0 text and each of the three data files against the source and executable archives.

components.name: GitHub mark from Simple Icons
components.scope: Repository source and Windows package icon asset
components.review: The release checker requires the documented source asset and its packaged path.

components.name: Lucide Square Pen icon
components.scope: Repository source and Windows package icon asset
components.review: The release checker requires the documented source asset and its ISC notice in the executable archive.

components.name: Adapted PyInstaller setuptools data hook
components.scope: Repository source and source archive
components.review: The hook retains its PyInstaller license header, and the executable package contains the exact PyInstaller COPYING text used by the pinned build.

components.name: CPython runtime
components.license: Python Software Foundation License and separately licensed bundled components
components.scope: Windows package
components.review: The package build pins CPython 3.14.7 and copies its base installation LICENSE.txt, which includes PSF-2.0 and the bundled bzip2, libffi, and Zstandard notices. Expat, libmpdec, Unicode data, and zlib-ng are inventoried separately.

components.name: CPython Expat parser
components.scope: Windows package; pyexpat extension
components.review: CPython 3.14.7 bundles Expat 2.8.2 in pyexpat.pyd; the exact vendored COPYING notice is included in the executable package.

components.name: CPython decimal arithmetic library
components.scope: Windows package; _decimal extension
components.review: CPython 3.14.7 bundles libmpdec 4.0.0 in _decimal.pyd; the package reproduces its source copyright and BSD-3-Clause conditions.

components.name: CPython Unicode Character Database
components.scope: Windows package; unicodedata extension data
components.review: The CPython 3.14.7 generated Unicode database identifies UCD 16.0.0; the Unicode License v3 notice accompanies unicodedata.pyd.

components.name: CPython zlib-ng implementation
components.scope: Windows package; bundled in the CPython interpreter DLL
components.review: CPython 3.14.7 pins zlib-ng 2.2.4 and the selected runtime reports 1.3.1.zlib-ng; its Zlib license is included alongside the CPython license.

components.name: OpenSSL runtime
components.scope: Windows package via CPython
components.review: The package build pins OpenSSL 3.5.7 and includes its Apache-2.0 license text.

components.name: PySide6 Essentials, shiboken6, and Qt
components.scope: Windows package; dynamically loaded framework and binding files
components.review: The release checker inventories every packaged Qt DLL, PYD, and plugin, requires every maintained Qt attribution file, and verifies the corresponding-source links and separate replaceable library layout.

components.name: python-vlc bindings
components.scope: Windows package; binding is a replaceable Python source file outside the PyInstaller archive
components.review: The source and executable archives must contain the same SHA-256-pinned vlc.py outside the EXE; the application loads it from python-vlc/vlc.py and the EXE audit blocks a frozen vlc module.

components.name: VLC 3.0.24 runtime and selected plugins
components.scope: Windows package
components.review: The release checker matches the packaged plugin set to this review and verifies the source archive manifest and pinned inputs.

components.name: FFmpeg and VLC build dependencies
components.license: FFmpeg LGPL/GPL terms; zlib; GSM; OpenJPEG BSD-2-Clause; libsamplerate BSD-3-Clause; MinGW-w64/winpthreads MIT-style terms

components.review: The separate source archive contains the selected VLC source, pinned FFmpeg commit, VLC build recipes and patches, and checksummed dependency source archives; the package excludes the FreeType plugin.

components.name: pycryptodomex

components.review: The package build pins PyCryptodome 3.23.0 and copies its distribution license file.

components.name: setuptools
